dedupe_keys.name: database for the development of capacity relationships for earth dam

description: Database for the Development of Capacity Relationships for Earth Dam is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This project provides a dataset that contains 94 case histories of earth dam performance during earthquakes since the 1906 San Francisco earthquake to the 2011 Tohoku, Japan earthquake. These case histories were used to develop seismic capacity relationships for earth dams in He and Rathje (2023). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pwtv-p173. Keywords: Database, Earthquake, Case Histories, Earth Dam. Published 2023-05-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
